text_block_list.text:
"Having claimed 1st place for the first 
time, Haru Urara burns with motivation to 
run in many more races from here on."

Before heading home, the shopping district 
folks who came out to cheer raise a banner 
to celebrate Haru Urara's debut.

To live up to the expectations of the 
shopping district folks who loved her, 
Haru Urara vowed to become even stronger.
